<function name="GetMouseWheel" parent="CUserCmd" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the scroll delta as whole number.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Scroll delta</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>

<code>
hook.Add( "StartCommand", "StartCommandExample", function( ply, cmd )
	if ( cmd:GetMouseWheel() != 0 ) then print( ply, " scrolled ", cmd:GetMouseWheel()) end
end )
</code>

</example>
